title: MDL-GBG: A Non-parametric and Interpretable Granular-Ball Generation Method for Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2605.08759v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Granular-ball generation requires deciding whether a local region should be retained, split, or partially refined, yet existing methods commonly rely on separate criteria for these decisions. This paper proposes Minimum Description Length-based Granular-Ball Generation (MDL-GBG), a non-parametric and interpretable method that formulates granular-ball generation as local model competition under the Minimum Description Length principle. For each granular ball, three candidate models are considered: a single-ball model, a two-ball model, and a core-ball-residual model. The model with the shortest description length determines whether the current region is retained, split, or partially refined, allowing granular balls to be generated without specifying their number in advance. translated_title: MDL-GBG：一种无参数且可解释的粒球生成聚类方法
translated_abstract: 粒球生成需要决定局部区域应当被保留、分裂还是部分细化，然而现有方法通常依赖彼此独立的判据来进行这些决策。本文提出基于最小描述长度（MDL）原理的粒球生成方法MDL-GBG，这是一种无参数且可解释的方法，将粒球生成表述为MDL原则下的局部模型竞争问题。对于每个粒球，考虑三种候选模型：单球模型、双球模型和核心球-残差模型。具有最短描述长度的模型决定当前区域是被保留、分裂还是部分细化，从而使粒球无需预先指定数量即可生成。在获得稳定的粒球之后，残差重分配机制会对核心-残差细化过程中被分离的样本进行重新评估……
tldr: 本文提出基于最小描述长度原理的无参数可解释粒球生成方法MDL-GBG，通过单球、双球和核心-残差三种局部模型的竞争来自动决定粒球的保留、分裂或细化，无需预先指定粒球数量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MDL-GBG, a non-parametric and interpretable granular-ball generation method that formulates granular-ball generation as local model competition among single-ball, two-ball, and core-ball-residual models under the Minimum Description Length principle, allowing automatic decisions on retaining, splitting, or refining granular balls without pre-specifying their number.
